texts: mixed: the denial, the per-wraith rule and the explicit "no" all come through and the rule fires, but the twenty-six-year window rests on the translator reading a bare "in twenty-six years" as "within the last twenty-six years" — a reading the instruction set licenses only for an explicit backward-window phrase, so a later re-parse could drop the window or slot it as a duration instead. Make the window explicit: "No wraith has emerged in the past twenty-six years."
